messages:
Maya P: heads-up: rolling a minimal runtime rebase tomorrow 01:30 UTC to pick up glibc hotfix CVE-2026-0456. need quick alignment on attestations, sbom, and an emergency RBAC bypass flow for CI.
Ben T: timeline? will this be a live canary or image swap?
Maya P: canary 2% global for 1h, then progressive. we'll push signed artifact + SLSA provenance and attach sbom.json artifact.
Oscar S: for signing we plan to use an ephemeral KMS-wrapped cosign key stored in vault. prefer ephemeral rather than long-lived KMS key grant to CI.
Aisha (sec): security: ok to use ephemeral, but we need auditable bindings and a short-lived auditor role that can verify signatures and read provenance. Also require KMS access reviews after rollback.
Nina Q: runtime: admission webhook will validate both cosign sig and provenance predicate for base-image-variant. we need the verifier public key and an allowed provenance predicate in config before rollout.
Ben T: RBAC question: CI runner (baker-ci) needs to push to staging registry and sign. propose granting a namespaced Role with registry:write + vault:unwrap only for the job duration. revoke after job completes.
Maya P: example Role YAML snippet for review:
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: ephemeral-baker-role
  namespace: ci-builds
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
```
Ben T: fine, but we also need artifact push perms on the registry side; will create a short-lived token via registry-token-service.
Oscar S: audit logging: we'll emit three events: KMS AsymmetricSign, cosign push, and SBOM publish. route them to secure-audit and to the incident slack channel via audit-bridge.
Aisha (sec): ensure SBOM contains package-manager metadata and libc build IDs to make triage fast. add a tag 'patched-cve:2026-0456' in the provenance.
release-oncall: oncall: please keep pager on during the window. if errors >2x baseline or failed attestation rate >0.5% rollback immediately.
Nina Q: runtime impact: new seccomp profile tightens ptrace, mounts, and disables CAP_SYS_ADMIN. some init tasks used mount propagation; we need a canary-exempt opt-in label for those pods.
Maya P: i'll enumerate affected deployments and prepare patches. also planning a preflight smoke job that runs in-cluster checks: image verify, sbom validation, and a small e2e ignoring non-critical infra.
devops-bot: ci-job 54876 started: build->sbom->cosign-sign. status: queued.
Ben T: got the RBAC binding ready in a dry-run. sharing link to PR in infra: https://git.internal/r/infra/ephemeral-role-pr / pls review.
Oscar S: admission webhook config stub for ops to apply:
```
verifier: 
  public_key: |
    -----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----
    ...
    -----END PUBLIC KEY-----
  accepted_provenance_predicates:
    - builder: "github.com/redwood/builder"
    - tag_contains: "glibc-2026-0456"
```
Aisha (sec): also add monitoring alerts for: attestation.fail_rate > 0.1% and sbom.missing_fields > 0.1%. evidence collection required: list of signers, KMS access grant, and sink entries for the KMS logs.
Maya P: post-deploy tasks:
- attach sbom + provenance to release notes
- post KMS access review doc in the release thread
- run regression harness: enclave-escape, mount-namespace smoke, and privileged-rewrite test
release-oncall: i'll be active. if rollback needed use tag rsec/priv-svc:prepatch-stable and trigger admission verifier to reject new tag.
Ben T: one more: for emergency hotpatch workflow, add an escape hatch to allow pre-approved signers (security leads) to sign bypass images with explicit audit-comment. we'll require manual 2-step approval in vault.
Aisha (sec): approved if 2 approvers from sec+eng. must include justification in the audit log.
Maya P: thanks all. i'll open the release thread with checklist and PR links. keep comments in this thread quick so we can merge infra items tonight. :thumbsup:
